evaluation_kind: recorded-trace timing replay of the frozen scheduler scored by a model-simulated drift reference; NOT a real-QPU experiment and no outcomes are simulated

provenance_labels.recorded_trace_timing_replay: arrival pattern, queueing, waiting, measurement separation, idle slots and completions
provenance_labels.model_simulated: p_A, p_B, Delta_measured, Delta_reference, comparison error and reliability, from a drift model fitted on the training portion only and evaluated at those times (not device observations)
provenance_labels.synthetic_stress: scenarios with drift-rate factor != 1 are synthetic stress tests, never the primary result

definitions.Delta_measured: p_A(t_A) - p_B(t_B), t_A and t_B the policy's execution times
definitions.Delta_reference: p_A(t_ref) - p_B(t_ref), t_ref the midpoint of the fixed window containing the request's arrival (same for all policies)
definitions.synchronous_error: diagnostic: reference at the comparison's own earlier execution time; isolates the drift between the two executions
definitions.reliable: completed and E_AB <= 0.05 (threshold fixed in advance, inclusive)
definitions.reliable_comparison_throughput: reliable completed comparisons / device time; primary denominator = budgeted device time (total_slots * slot_seconds, idle slots included, identical for all policies); busy-time variant also reported
definitions.time_separation: abs(execution time of the second measurement - execution time of the first) of each completed comparison
definitions.waiting_time: execution time - arrival time per executed shot of a completed comparison

metadata.score_formula: priority_score = 1.0 / (mean_abs_z + 1e-12); 0.0 if training data is insufficient

priority_analysis_cross_check.note: cross-check only; this run's priorities were calculated freshly and are not read from the file

drift_model.equation: p_l(t) = A + B exp(-l/l0) sin(2 pi l t_w Omega(t)); Omega(t) = gamma_0 + sum_w gamma_w f_w(t)
drift_model.selection_rule: min mean validation log loss = 0.710785; candidates within 0.001 nats: [2]; lowest BIC among them -> K=2

validity_diagnostic_after_freezing.note: scored on holdout outcomes AFTER the model was frozen; influences nothing
validity_diagnostic_after_freezing.caveat: the frozen model does not forecast the holdout drift when its log loss exceeds the constant baseline; results describe scheduling under this simulated drift, not the real device

bootstrap.method: paired circular temporal block bootstrap over time-ordered requests
bootstrap.note: intervals reflect which time blocks were observed, not uncertainty in the drift-model parameters

checks.name: same_source_shots_and_measurement_budget
checks.detail: every policy saw exactly the same 9648 shots (one shot per slot)

checks.name: same_device_capacity_and_time_budget
checks.detail: one slot grid (9648 slots x 0.7568363221726959 s)

checks.name: same_arrival_pattern_and_initial_queue
checks.detail: all policies start at the first arrival with an empty queue and see identical arrival times

checks.name: same_reference_values_independent_of_scheduler
checks.detail: Delta_reference is recomputed from the model and the request's arrival window only; identical for every policy

checks.name: same_simulated_drift_for_all_policies
checks.detail: each policy's errors equal an independent recomputation with the one drift model

checks.name: priorities_fresh_training_only_and_frozen
checks.detail: priorities recalculated for this run from all 63041 training shots; one frozen mapping shared by the policies that use priorities

checks.name: no_holdout_in_model_or_priorities
checks.detail: model fitted on observations up to 21919.8 s and priorities on shots up to 21919.8 s, both before the boundary 21920.355064249998 s

limitations: The drift is a model fitted on the training portion; it is not the real holdout drift.
Errors scale with circuit wait length; the Comparable pairs are the low-wait-length circuits, so errors are small.
Stress scenarios multiply the drift rate synthetically and say nothing about the real device.
